title: Replay run on a Boolean word
statement: Let $x$ and $r$ be Boolean words, and let $p$ be a valid input-head position for $x$. For all Boolean words $u,v$ and output words $o$, the replay machine started on input $x$ with input-head position $p$, active state, work tape containing $uv$ with its head at position $|u|$, and output $o$ reaches after $|v|+1$ steps a halted configuration with input-head position $p$, work tape still containing $uv$ with its head at position $|uv|$, and output $ov$.
